drafted_from: tool:send-signed-test-calls's own row (tools/notice-when-something-shows-up/what-this-tool-does-and-how-to-run-it.json: its words, input schema and sample run) and tests/send-signed-test-calls.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Prove my webhook address https://shop.example.test/webhooks/mail with my held signing secret mail-webhook-signing-secret: one good call, a wrong signature, none, a stale one, one too large and the good one again." It runs tool:send-signed-test-calls and answers each call's status and reply, such as {"calls":[{"label":"signed","sent_at":"2026-11-25T12:00:00.000Z","status":200,"reply":"{\"recorded\":true,\"changes\":1,\"duplicates\":0}"},{"label":"bad-signature","sent_at":"2026-11-25T12:00:00.000Z","status":401,"reply":"{\"recorded\":false,\"reason\":\"signature-mismatch\"}"}]}
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it sends made-up calls to your own address and answers what came back.
instructions: 1. Keep the service's signing secret in your vault under a name of yours (the value the service showed when the webhook was made), bound to your receiver's host only. It is never typed into the request.

2. Say how the service signs (most senders: signed "{id}.{ts}.{body}", sha256, base64, secret_prefix "whsec_", secret_encoding base64) and which headers carry the id, the timestamp and the signature (Resend: svix-id, svix-timestamp, svix-signature "v1,{sig}").

3. List the calls in order, each with a label: a made-up body, and signature good, bad or none, age_seconds for a stale timestamp, pad_bytes to go over the receiver's size cap, or same_as to send an earlier call again exactly.

4. Read what comes back: each call's status and the receiver's reply. A good call answers 2xx, a wrong, missing or stale signature 401, too large 413, and the same call again 2xx as a duplicate. The secret and the signatures are never shown.

worked_examples.title: A good call and a wrong signature
worked_examples.ask: Send my receiver a signed made-up delivered event and the same event with a wrong signature.
worked_examples.given: The row's sample run: a made-up held secret and a receiver answering 200 then 401. Addresses and ids are synthetic.
